"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"69 separate programs, administered by 10 different agencies, provide education or care to children under the age of 5.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Nine separate agencies administer 44 different programs for job training.",

"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The federal government has operated within a rigged system lacking transparency for more than three decades since the enactment of the Budget Act of 1974 by a Democrat-controlled Congress.",
